description: Extends the org-wide policy for published KMP libraries (automerge baseline, 3-day soak, kotlin-toolchain and first-party holds — see meshtastic/.github:kmp-library.json for rationale). Local rules below are additive to the preset, not stricter. The third-party Gradle baseline automerges after the soak, gated on the required `api-check`, so a bump that moves the ABI goes red rather than merged. The holds that matter here are the preset's own: majors, the kotlin-toolchain group, and every org.meshtastic coordinate, plus the protobufs note below. packageRules apply in order and the last match wins, so these rules override the preset's.

prBodyNotes: Bumps the `org.meshtastic:protobufs` artifact (the wire schema). Review the regenerated API diff carefully — new `oneof` arms break exhaustive `when` for consumers; run `./gradlew updateKotlinAbi`. See `docs/versioning.md`.
